title: Host Terms, Section 8 — The Minimum-Stay Floor of a Listing (Roamhaven Listings)
content:
# Section 8 — The Minimum-Stay Floor of a Listing

*Roamhaven host terms for Roamhaven Listings.*

**8.1** A listing's minimum stay may be no shorter than its minimum-stay floor and no longer than the space type's minimum-night ceiling, and a minimum stay standing below the floor is raised to the floor exactly, the change being logged as one change of the minimum stay; a minimum stay at or above the floor is left as it stands.

**8.2** The minimum-stay floor is counted in whole nights. It is the space type's minimum-night floor plus the listing's party-prevention nights, worked out on the day of the change.

**8.3** Party-prevention nights of every kind are first added together into one figure, and that figure is added to the space type's minimum-night floor. A listing that carries no party-prevention nights has the space type's minimum-night floor as its minimum-stay floor.

## Inputs

- The listing's space type and its minimum-night floor and minimum-night ceiling.
- The minimum stay standing on the listing.
- The listing's party-prevention nights on the day of the change.

## Worked example (hypothetical listing with no party-prevention nights)

Suppose a space type whose minimum-night floor were 2 nights and whose minimum-night ceiling were 365 nights.

| Minimum stay on the listing | Minimum-stay floor | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 night | 2 nights | raised to 2 nights; one change of the minimum stay is logged |
| 2 nights | 2 nights | left as it stands |
| 5 nights | 2 nights | left as it stands |
